name: Kahoku (Ishikawa, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kahoku city emblem in green and blue: green stylised leaves around a blue swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Kahoku, a city in Ishikawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 March 2004.

features.role: Kahoku city emblem — green stylised leaves around a blue swirl
